published_images.label: Intervention technique sur une rame de métro
published_images.prompt: One full bleed 4:3 landscape PNG size 1448×1086, reference images solely for the smooth semi-realistic two-dimensional TCF PAINTING style (including the whole background), matte natural light and color, discreet drawn contours and believable perspective. No people or outfits copied from refs. No text, numerals, arrows or brands. A metro technician around 50, a tall lean woman with warm olive skin and short salt-and-pepper curls wearing orange maintenance vest, is working on a stopped metro set next to a grounded red-edged triangular board with a large wrench pictogram alone. A short broad-bodied older dark-skinned passenger in a plum coat waits at a safe distance farther along the platform. No readable sign, letters, numbers or large grid. Maintain recognizable underground station, generous walking clearance, matte painted walls and equipment.
published_images.review_note: La technicienne et le panneau à pictogramme expliquent la panne, avec une autre personne en retrait. Le quai et les volumes de la station sont peints sans panneau lisible.
